description:
FOUND s473t5e (#1501 round 6, `re/` CHECK 2).  t/re/reg_namedcapture.t is
DIFF 1/1 and its failing row is the file's first:

    *X = *-;
    'X' =~ /(?<X>X)/;
    print eval '*X{HASH}{X} || 1' ? "" : "not ", "ok 1\n";

i.e. alias the glob `X` to the glob `-` (whose HASH slot is `%-`, the
named-capture hash), match, then read the alias's HASH slot.  Its comment says
what it is for: "This tests whether glob assignment fails to load the tie."
The second row, the same trick over `*!`/`%!`, PASSES.

This is #1664's territory -- the TYPEGLOB MODEL (a glob value in a stash slot
IS `*{name}`; `*x{IO}`/`*x{FORMAT}` missing) -- plus #1717's (perl's `%-` is a
`Tie::Hash::NamedCapture` tie, PCL's is native).  Filed separately only because
it names a THIRD slot spelling, `*X{HASH}`, over a PUNCTUATION glob.

ROWS: 1.  Close it with #1664 rather than on its own.
subject: `*X = *-` then `*X{HASH}{X}`: a glob assignment does not carry the named-capture hash, and `*X{HASH}` has no slot to read -- #1664's typeglob model, t/re/reg_namedcapture.t
